changelog:
quit-weed 1.0.0 initial release

- New skill to support cannabis tolerance breaks or quitting with streak tracking and craving management.
- Track your clean streak, set custom quit goals, and receive daily progress updates.
- Access instant craving support with grounding and motivation tools.
- View a science-backed clarity timeline outlining benefits at key milestones.
- All data remains local for complete privacy.
summary: Take a tolerance break or quit cannabis with streak tracking and craving support
